title: A page reload the user cancels leaves the cloud picker locked until it is closed and reopened
evidence: A finished move hands the page to a reload (widget-src/standalone/switch-flow.ts: settled leads to navigating). If the reload does not happen, the flow stays navigating while the picker is open; restored comes only from a back-forward cache page show, and reopened only when the picker mounts again, which returns it to idle.
